title: Keep a fixed value
summary: Swift: Keep a fixed value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: let makes a constant. Its value cannot be changed after it is set.
learningObjectives: Keep a fixed value with Swift

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.
let binds pencils to 3. Addition returns 5 without changing the constant.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use var when a stored value must change later.
